notes: Step 1 parts were correct and are unchanged.
The button straddles the centre gap. Side 1 (1.l, 1.r) is in columns 10 and 11 of the top half, and side 2 (2.l, 2.r) is in the same columns of the bottom half.
The red wire carries 5V to the button's side 1 (strip 10t). The teal wire goes from Uno pin 2 to the opposite side of the button (strip 11b).
The 10k pull-down resistor is on the same strip (11b) as the pin 2 wire. Its other leg goes to strip 14b, which the black wire takes to Uno GND.1. This matches the schematic.
Exact breadboard holes are my choice, since the image does not show them clearly. The topology follows the schematic.
The LED on pin 13 is the Uno's built-in LED, so no external LED is added.
